skill (the chapter correctly distinguishes skills from slash commands but uses 'slash command' in some places where 'skill' is the canonical term)

proposed_new_terms.definition: The optimization in SkillTool.checkPermissions that auto-allows skills whose only non-trivial properties are in the SAFE_SKILL_PROPERTIES set, reducing permission fatigue for safe skills.
A skill with a paths frontmatter field that is not loaded into the tool listing at startup but is activated when the model operates on files matching the declared glob patterns.
The process of discovering skills from .claude/skills directories encountered during file operations, as opposed to the startup-time scan.
